ai_summary: Bonlon Industries Limited has scheduled a meeting for October 22, 2026, to finalize the specific terms, including issue price and entitlement ratio, for its previously approved Rights Issue, aiming to raise up to Rs. 49.75 crore. This upcoming capital raise holds material implications for existing shareholders, potentially leading to dilution if they do not subscribe, and has prompted the closure of the trading window to prevent insider trading. Based on this standard regulatory announcement, there are no immediate red flags identifiable within the document.
